name: Hijack Jump
storyline:
You climb. Anyone else can shoot you down. Really, anyone.
Hundreds of other players can shoot you down with toilets? Yes! You’ll face extremely tricky and varied parkour — but beware: you’re never safe. Other players can hijack and sabotage you at any moment!

Parkour
Take on a towering, complex parkour course that spans different themes and areas. Rolling pillars, firing cannons, and countless obstacles are waiting to make your life miserable. If that's not enough, there’s still Hardcore Mode, without any save points. But trust us - that’s not all!

Hijack
This is where it gets wild. Think you can just focus on your own run? Wrong! Anyone can join your game session and start shooting. Whether they try to shoot you off with a giant ball or a saxophone, the outcome is always unpredictable. Now imagine 100 hijackers out to get you… tricky, right?

Co-op
Not everything has to be a solo struggle. In co-op mode, you and your friends can team up to conquer the course together. Work as a team to overcome obstacles, reach savepoints, and celebrate every hard-earned jump side by side. Of course, hijackers can still crash the party – so stick together if you want to survive the chaos.
summary: Hijack Jump is a tricky parkour game where your success depends on friends… or enemies. Every player can be hijacked by others. Hijackers don’t just watch – they can interfere with your run, blasting you with stuff to knock you down. There’s no limit to how many spectators can join and mess with your game.
